verdict: Home row painter defect confirmed; Menu Escape defect rejected as feedback-clock fixture mismatch

findings.evidence: paint_action fills each row and writes literal ▎ at line 501 irrespective of StateFlags or resolved gutter glyph. Correctly clocked RustDirty frame4000 120x40: query focus green bar (1,4), fifteen white bars at x1 rows7,8,9,10,13,16..25; all fifteen persist under menu while actual query focus bar disappears. These are not domain text: renderer itself writes each in the designated GUTTER cell. NavList lines928..951 supplies FOCUSED/FOCUS_VISIBLE only to cursor row, so flags distribution is not cause.
findings.fix_contract: Remove raw render_row/paint_action bypass only when shared row replacement passes real-App focused/blurred/inactive-layer decoded-cell and hit/focus checks. Use NavList::row with RowUi/ColumnsUi semantic parts, cursor_style Fill for query-owned rows. Domain supplies view data and typed actions; shared component owns gutter glyph, selected fill, hover/press/disabled styling, clipping and row hit area. Do not replace literal glyph with another app-side focus condition.

rejected_findings.cause: Header test uses Harness::new monotonic clock for simulation App. synchronize_feedback app.rs1992 fails; app.update app.rs2191 adds Response::changed, which core/response.rs81 marks Flow::Consumed. Runtime runtime.rs1766..1805 only performs automatic Esc dismissal when unconsumed. Correct FeedbackClock::Simulation initialized from App::fixture_time_ms closes menu, restores home.query, diagnostics empty across widths119/120/121 and all four color profiles. Monotonic negative control reproduces mismatch status and menu remaining open.
rejected_findings.required_correction: Fix header test clock setup and restore actual Escape/focus-restoration assertions; no MenuBar or Runtime workaround.

frozen_contract.meaning: One FINDER query focus owner; query uses conditional gutter_symbol; result rows use cursor_row(CursorStyle::Fill), selected › at x+1, no unconditional ▎. Five measured columns and heterogeneous Explore rows mean replacing current Home generic painter alone cannot establish complete frozen Finder parity.
